title: Teaching Vision-Language Models to Use the Scale They Are Given: Label-Free Equivariance Training for Metric Physical Reasoning
keywords: Teaching Vision-Language Models to Use the Scale They Are Given
abstract: Metric questions about video, such as the speed of a moving object, require a vision-language model to convert visual measurements into physical units using a real-world reference supplied in the prompt. We find that current models use this reference only partially. When every world-space quantity in the prompt is multiplied by a common factor, the prompt still describes the same video and the correct answer changes by exactly that factor, but the predictions of eight models change by less, and their accuracy stays concentrated near the scale that the depicted objects usually have. Asked the same physics in a scale-free form, the two models we test recover the closed-form scaling laws on most items, which indicates that the deficit lies in metric grounding and not in knowledge of the physical mechanism. Because the scaling relation is exact, it can serve as supervision without metric annotations. Equivariance Self-Distillation (EquiSD) projects a model's own prediction onto the functions that satisfy this relation and fine-tunes the model on the resulting targets, with one query per training question and no ground truth. Trained on synthetic video only, EquiSD brings a 3B model close to the exact relation on held-out simulated videos, also at scales not seen in training, and improves its accuracy across scales. Without adaptation, it also improves accuracy across scales on the QuantiPhy benchmark, where its gain reaches 93% of that obtained by supervision with exact simulator answers.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2609.00658v3 全文及 2026-10-06T11:31:35.887714+00:00 审阅记录；PDF 13 页，SHA-256 6f07b741cd2bbc817fc135bb7f41cb9f4e662bc3268d490117e9058531c23294，视觉核验第 1、6、8、13 页。数字均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态 not-found：PDF 说 releaseIVP-Sim 但没有此方法可核验 public code URL，不据声明猜链接。
analysis.ideaZh: EquiSD v3 修订的是科学解释边界：方法与主 MRA 结果未变，但 QuantiPhy159 题含 67real＋92Blender，+6.4/93% 是混合 benchmark；real-only 增益约 6.1、占 label gain82%。Fig4 换为训练 student 的 source slopes，纠正 v1 用了 pooled8models 数字的错配。无标签等变训练仍值得略读，本次不包装成新模型收益。
analysis.motivationZh: 视觉模型回答物理量时可能忽略题目给定的尺度，并依赖图像外观猜测；需要用不改变物理关系的输入变换建立一致监督，减少对新增数值标注的依赖。
analysis.methodZh: 模型 nominal 自答除 reference 得到 ratio，再把 prompt 中所有 suppliedworldquantities 与 target 同乘α做 answer-tokenSFT；只在 Qwen2.5-VL3B syntheticphysics 验证。v3 保持主 Tables4/5/6 数值，明确修正 real/synthetictransfer 范围、student-specificsource 诊断和等变关系条件。此次更新以避免夸大真实视频证据为目的。
methodFlow: 在 nominalscale 查询一次，去掉无 validanswer 题
自答除 reference 形成 scale-freeratio，等变投影
一致 rescale 所有 suppliedlength/rate/cameraquantities 及 target
LoRA 仅 answertokensSFT，输出 metricanswers 并同时评价 MRA/slope
analysis.experimentsZh:
实验设置：IVP-Sim1000videos/3000questions，train400questions134videos（4families）、test120questions40slidingvideos；338validnominalselfanswers 实际 SFT，fiveα中每题 3scales；QuantiPhy159 题 24videos，67real/92synthetic；sixunseenα。
作者报告 EquiSD held-outMRA+9.2/slope0.94，mixedQuantiPhy+6.4/slope0.57，主数字沿用 v1。（Table4,p.6）
作者报告 real-only EquiSD 约+6.1，对 labels+7.5；differenceCI[−4.4,+1.6]，未证明 realtransfer 胜 labels。（Table11,p.13）
比较范围：Transported/fixed/nominaltargets、self/exactsimulator、K1/K5、inferencecorrection，覆盖清晰。修复仅 one3Bbackbone，其他 8models 只诊断；closedAPI 和 localstudent 输入 protocol 不同。
消融与诊断：Targettransport 产生 scale 响应；K5 slope1.00 但 MRA28.0 低于 K1 30.0，differenceCI 含 0。Inferencecorrection 不改善，不能把训练约束变成无成本 testtimefix。
analysis.insightZh: 基础训练算法延续 v1，没有新增训练/model/capability 数字。Materialdelta 是证据来源与 diagnosticfigure 纠正：此前写成 realtransfer 的 159 题实为 mixed，sourcefigure 此前 studentlabel 配 pooled8modelslopes。改变如何解释科学结论，不是仅排版/版本 stamp。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: Metric 尺度与 dimensionalconstraints 对 spatial reasoning/设计检查有明确启发，但不是 structuredartifact 生成。重要的是以可检查 symmetry 训练 referencefaithfulness，而非已实现一般 physicalunderstanding。
analysis.evidenceZh:
同视频、固定 timebase 下所有 suppliedworldquantities 一致 rescale，target 维度 LT^-k；等变性不保证 absolute 正确。（Sec.3.1,p.3; Limitations,p.8；Full13 页读完，限制页已查看。）
作者报告主 training 仍 IVP-SimMRA20.8→30.0、QuantiPhy17.1→23.4，和 v1 相同。（v3Table4,p.6; archivedv1Table4,p.6；新旧表均实际查看，不宣称新 resultimprovement。）
v3 明确 159 题中 67real/92Blender；93% 为 all，real-only 为 82%，sourceweightedgain6.15 对 labels7.46。（Sec.5.3,Table11,pp.7,13; v1Sec.5.3,p.7；v1 直接把 QuantiPhy 描述为 realfootage，既有 review 也沿用；修订影响 transfer 证据边界。）
Fig4source-slopes 从 v1 0.42/0.89/0.82/0.93 改为 v3 student0.26/0.62/0.24/0.48。（v3Fig4,p.8; archivedv1Fig4,p.8；两幅图均视觉核验；旧值对应 pooled8models，不能作 untrained3Bstudent 诊断。）
analysis.caveatZh:
只适用于固定 timebase 和 LT^-k 量；unsupplieddimensionalconstant 相关问题无此保证。
完全等变也可能所有答案同倍数错误。
诊断 8models，repair 只 one3Bsyntheticcorpus/oneheld-outfamily，control2models。
本次没有新的主性能收益；更新必须写成 source/evidence 解释修订。
Real-only 结果和 mixedbenchmark 应分开，93% 不可再写成真实视频 labelgain 比例。
QuantiPhyvalidation 仅 159 题/24videos，所有 variance/CI 为作者 bootstrap，非独立复现。
主方法/结果未变，scope 修订后仍只是有限 physicsgrounding，不外推 CAD 可靠性。
